structure.unit: Waters of the State, Ports and Harbors
Mills, Dams and Certain Other Works on Watercourses

law.text: If, by such report, or otherwise, it appear that any person to whom notice has not been given, will sustain damage, notice shall be given to him, in the manner prescribed by § 62.1-117 to show cause why the applicant should not have the leave desired.
